summary: Frontend-only retest of the daily check-in popup fix (pendingDay now returns today's index from Day 1). Every requested scenario passed (6/6). Rohan (report about 1h old): the popup opened by itself on login showing 'Day 1 of 14', mood buttons 0-4 and the avatar. 'Remind me later' closed it and it stayed closed after a reload in the same browser session; the bell dot still showed, and both nav-checkin and bell-btn reopened it. Ananya (report about 13h old): the popup opened by itself showing Day 1. Flow tested: mood Steady, Continue, then 5 activities answered Y/N/Y/N/Y, then Submit. The toast 'New stage unlocked: Finding Calm' appeared and the popup closed. After a reload it did not reopen. streak-current=1, streak-earned=2/14, streak-badge-2 data-earned=true, journey-main-avatar data-stage=2, and the bell dot was gone. Clicking Daily Check-in then showed the toast "You're all caught up for today." On My Journey, dashboard-plan-progress rows read 1/14, 0/14, 1/14, 0/14, 1/14 (3/70). Edge cases, tested by temporarily changing Ananya's created_at: at 14.5 days old the popup showed 'Day 14 of 14'; at 16.5 days old there was no popup and no bell dot, and the nav showed the caught-up toast. Questions said 'today' and none said 'yesterday'; one question has no time word at all.

ui_bugs.issue: The question 'Did you do a 10-minute start on a task you were avoiding?' has no 'today'. Every other question says 'today'.

design_issues.screen: Home after the 14-day journey ends (more than 15 days)
issues: Calm Streak still says 'Complete today's check-in to grow into your next stage.' even though no check-in is possible any more.
The journey card still labels Day 14 as 'Today'.
The description repeats itself, e.g. 'A little calmer today. A little calmer already...' (stage caption followed by the badge message).

action_items: Optional: add 'today' to the a-10min question copy
Optional: change the cheer text in CalmStreak when elapsedDays > 15 (journey over)
critical_code_review_comments: pendingDay, DailyLog todayIdx, streakInfo cur and stages.todayIndex all use min(elapsed,13). They agree with each other.
closeDaily also writes the sessionStorage key after a save. That does no harm because pendingDay returns null once the day is logged.
